svg.title: SD07 — production load, meaningful mutation and save-failure restoration

g.text: SD07 — production load, meaningful mutation and save-failure restoration
Acquire exclusive OS file lock; reject second owning session
Strict JSON/version checks; absent new blueprint refs default to null
Restore draft maps and pending changes; subscribe fresh service observers
Invalid saved data aborts startup; no empty-store reset or automatic overwrite
Exception propagates; finally unlocks. No general operation-failure rollback asserted.
Verify external-change digest; validate DTO graph
Serialize to same-directory temp file; flush
Restore domain, drafts, pending proposals and observers; throw storage error
Return operation result only after persistence
replace uses ATOMIC_MOVE when supported, normal replacement fallback.
No backup history, universal power-loss guarantee or network multi-user store.
close releases file lock; lock-file existence alone is not a live lock.
